PORT.description: FlareSolverr proxy port. Railway injects PORT for routing.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Log level: debug, info, warn, error.

LOG_FILE.description: Log file path. Empty for stdout only.

LOG_HTML.description: Log full HTML responses (debug only — verbose).

CAPTCHA_SOLVER.description: Captcha solver provider. 'none' for Cloudflare-only challenges.

PROXY_URL.description: Upstream HTTP/SOCKS proxy URL (e.g. http://proxy:8080). Leave empty to disable.

PROXY_USERNAME.description: Proxy username. Only used with PROXY_URL.

PROXY_PASSWORD.description: Proxy password. Only used with PROXY_URL.
